title: 天蓋の断絶と、忘却の祭壇に捧ぐ挽歌
author: 竜胆 アルト

en.title: The Severance of the Heavens and the Elegy Offered to the Altar of Forgetting
en.premise: The "Immortal Lighthouse", fueled by people’s memories, shields the city from the world’s long slumber and void. The poor sell their memories to stay alive, while nobles collect others’ memories in pursuit of eternal knowledge. A fallen noble youth chasing the lost "Genesis Memory" confronts the brutal truth of the capital and yearns for the world’s awakening.

zh.title: 天盖的断绝与献给忘却祭坛的挽歌
zh.premise: 以人们的记忆为燃料的『不灭灯塔』守护城市，抵御世界深沉的沉睡与虚无。穷人通过出售记忆维持生命，贵族则收集他人记忆，追求永恒的知识。一个失落贵族青年追寻失落的『创世记忆』，直面首都残酷的真相，渴望唤醒世界。
